[Thinking]
**Extracting job keywords**

The user is looking for keywords from a job description, which I totally get! I need to gather relevant keywords and phrases that are important for a resume or ATS. 

I’ll create a bullet list that includes terms like Senior Technical Program Manager, program management, digital products, engineering teams, risk mitigation, stakeholder management, Agile, and more. I also want to mention specifics about experience, like “8+ years” and “4+ years TPM.” 

Okay, time to compile that clean bullet list!
[/Thinking]

Here are concise keywords and phrases extracted from the job description (use for resume/ATS):

- Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM)
- Technical Program Management
- Program / Project / Product Management
- Cross-functional engineering teams
- Digital initiatives / Digital products
- Enterprise-class applications
- Software engineering program management
- Full program lifecycle / SDLC
- Stakeholder management / Stakeholder engagement
- Risk mitigation
- Issue resolution
- Prioritization / Roadmapping
- Delivery-focused / Track record of delivery
- Leadership / Provide leadership
- Collaboration / Cross-team collaboration
- Communication skills / Communicate clearly
- Fast-paced environment
- Consumer-obsessed
- Front-end design and technologies (high-level)
- Engineering practice improvement / Process improvement
- Metrics and reporting
- Healthcare / CVS Health Digital
- 8+ years IT/Digital experience
- 4+ years TPM experience
